name: Protocol v1 addendum A: model selection and experiment execution rules
why_an_addendum: Protocol v1 fixes metrics and FPR budgets but does not define how hyper-parameters and the model family are selected, nor how comparison experiments reuse configurations. These rules are fixed before any model is trained (2026-09-23) and before any test prediction exists. They add rules; they change nothing in v1.

data_use.early_stopping: LightGBM only; validation partition; binary_logloss; patience 50 rounds
data_use.test: scored once per frozen experiment after configs/m4_frozen.json exists; never used for any decision

selection_metric.primary: validation recall at the 0.1 % FPR operating point (threshold chosen on validation with ids.metrics.select_threshold, max_fpr=0.001)
selection_metric.tie_break: if primary values differ by < 0.001: higher validation PR-AUC; then lower fit time
selection_metric.rationale: an IDS is operated under a false-alarm budget; recall at the strictest pre-declared budget is the operational criterion. PR-AUC and ROC-AUC are reported for every candidate but are not the selection target, because they average over operating points with unacceptable false-alarm volumes.

selection_scope: Step 1: within each family (lr, rf, lgbm), pick the best searched configuration on chrono/primary/default (experiment E1).
Step 2: across the three family winners, pick the overall selected model with the same rule. All three family winners are evaluated on test as predeclared baselines.
thresholds: for every trained experiment model: thresholds for FPR budgets 0.001 and 0.01 from its own validation predictions; frozen in configs/m4_frozen.json before test scoring

experiments.E1_primary: chrono x primary x default; lr, rf, lgbm (small searches)
experiments.E2_random_comparison: random x primary x default; each family retrained with its E1-selected hyper-parameters (no re-tuning); own validation thresholds
experiments.E3_feature_ablation: chrono x primary x {default_plus_dst_port, no_tcp_window, no_header_length}; overall selected family with its E1 hyper-parameters (no re-tuning); own validation thresholds
experiments.E4_attempted_sensitivity: chrono x excl_attempted x default; overall selected family with its E1 hyper-parameters; own validation thresholds
experiments.E5_label_independent_temporal: feasibility analysis only unless it answers an interpretable question (decided before any training on it)

lightgbm_iterations_in_comparisons: E2-E4 use the same early-stopping rule on their own validation data (the number of rounds is a fitted quantity, not a tuned hyper-parameter)
search_budget_rule: search spaces are fixed after a single benchmark run per family (runtime only) and recorded in search_spaces below before the search starts; if a family's single fit exceeds 15 minutes, its grid is reduced and the reduction is documented
benchmark_observation: Single benchmark fits on E1 (8 threads): lr 13 s, rf (25 trees) 18 s, lgbm 18 s (early stop at 178 rounds); peak RSS 4.7 GB. No grid reduction needed. Recorded 2026-09-23 before the search.

_why.lr: C (regularisation strength) and class weighting (1:3.2 benign:attack imbalance) are the parameters that change a linear model's ranking; preprocessing is fixed (signed log1p + standardise, one-hot codes).
_why.rf: tree count fixed at 100 (more trees only reduce variance); depth and leaf size control over-fitting to repeated scenario vectors; max_features fixed at sqrt (standard).
_why.lgbm: learning rate fixed at 0.05 with validation early stopping (rounds are fitted); num_leaves and min_child_samples control tree complexity.
